'''Capra''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] along the [[Saeduree River]]. It was home to the planet's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. A [[Chorba Chuggers|speakeasy]] in the city was located between an [[Unidentified electronics repair shop|electronics repair shop]] and a [[Unidentified fabric retailer|fabric shop]], and was one of the only places to obtain [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] on the planet.<ref name="SoR" />
